notes.title: Multiplayer - The Final Re-work
notes.notes:
Multiplayer - The Final Re-work
2025.5.3.0

I've never been satisfied with how multiplayer was setup in our game. The fact that you had to have a separate account, a separate computer, the way servers had their own disconnected universe, all this effort to host. 

No longer! The game now basically ALWAYS uses your single-player file and let's you join sessions with your friends similar to that of Lethal Company in that anyone can host a lobby and have users (or friends only) join them.

New terminal added to create a lobby
On the main menu, a new list of friends playing is visible, allowing for you to quickly hop into the same lobby as a friend
A list of public lobbies is also available
Lobbies can be Public or Friends Only
Lobbies can be Password Protected
You can right click a friend in Steam and join them any time. If you are already playing, you will join that lobby WITHOUT going back to the main menu (All your entities will despawn and the room owners entities will sync up)
While there technically is a lobby host, every person can act as a host for entities and items. The first user in a room is the host of new enemies.
Lobbies can have a max of 250 users. Will Steam and Amaranth be able to handle that? Eh, who knows.
Player Movement, Entity, Items, and most Attacks properly sync

There is currently many bugs as we transition to this new system. Future plans include
> Finishing the attack syncing
> Fix many bugs associated with online and current playable areas
> Syncing Knockback
> Getting gamemodes (Race and Ambush) working again

We hope you like this new direction and look forward to this being the FINALY implementation of multiplayer and moving onto more core features soon!  

⚠ Please download the demo to test out this build ⚠

notes.title: Ambush Gamemode Update!
notes.notes:
The new Ambush update is out! Head over to our steam page and/or discord for a full list of what this update entails.

+ Added Ambush Gamemode: This gamemode, as it currently stands, lets you fight against 5 waves of enemies. You can switch between any element at the start of the game, but you have to keep it for the rest of the time.
+ Added Stickler: This grasshopper-like insect bounces around the map. If it sees an enemy nearby, it will hide away in its spikey shell.
+ Added Spiny Stickler: This variant of the stickler will shoot out its spikes when an enemy is nearby. It's sprite-work is currently not in. Watch for a patch soon to update that.
+ Added Flitcut Drone: This small flying insect flutters about the map. If it spots an enemy, it will hunt it down for an attack! Watch out for swarms of them!
* Updated most of the player moves. They are still being worked on, but look a lot nicer now.
+ Added a shader system. Currently, the only shader being used at the moment is a screen shake when the player does certain attacks.

Hello, Nona! The Project Amaranth Teams have been working on our half release and we have a video for you to check out: [url=http://bit.ly/HouseCommercial]http://bit.ly/HouseCommercial[/url]!

Additionally, Demo version 2.41 is out now!

- Time. Some environments can now change with the season. It's currently fall when I wrote this.
- House Editor. You can't buy houses or house items yet, but the foundation is there! Go enter your house and play with the door or something
- Map Editor Stuff: There is a bit too much to mention here. 
- Player Moves: Lots of the players abilities have been modified. Test them out in the map editor!
- New Server System: It's still a baby, so it does not have all the old features yet!
- Check out #change_log in our discord for more details

If you have not joined our discord yet, click this link to be a part of the community: [url=https://discord.gg/vkA3MXf]https://discord.gg/vkA3MXf[/url]!

Map Making Contest!
This event lasts until next Friday! Submit your maps here: [url=https://forms.gle/BSuutZw18TANMw84A]https://forms.gle/BSuutZw18TANMw84A[/url]

notes.title: Stable Release
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, community![/b] The [b]Project Amaranth[/b] development team has been considering ways to bring content to you faster. What we have come up with is a [b]“Stable Release.”[/b] Those of you with the demo will be able to access early content ahead of our bigger releases. This will include new map editor features, possibly new gamemodes, and more! The [b]Stable Release[/b] is available now.

To access: You must have the demo downloaded. Right click 'Project Amaranth' and click properties. Go to the betas tab and in the drop down menu select 'stable.' The game will update automatically.

As always development will continue on our bigger release of the [b]Nature Region[/b]. We hope you continue to be patient with us as we make further progress.

[b]Enjoy!
[/b]
